title: Release Train Weekly Prep - 2026-03-04
content:
Purpose: quick sync ahead of Friday go/no-go for release-train Mar-2026. Personal prep / checklist I want to run through in the meeting. Notes to self and items to raise if any blocker remains.

Agenda (15-20m):
- Quick status: infra, runtime, console, telemetry (2m each)
- Go/No-Go checklist review (5m)
- Open blockers, owners, ETA (5m)
- Rollout plan + canary window (3m)
- Post-launch monitoring + immediate rollback criteria (2m)

Go/No-Go checklist (must confirm each) - mark Y/N in meeting:
1) Build & integration: final smoke test on staging passed (runtime image v2.14.1) - OWNER: Samir (smoke ok? Y)
2) Infra: Dedicated pool capacity reserved for first 24h, autoscale policy validated - OWNER: Priya (confirm node counts & quotas)
3) Config: model pinning and fallback policies configured in routing rules - OWNER: Maya
4) Migrations: KV / cache schema changes applied and backfilled on staging - OWNER: DB team / Samir
5) Canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 3h with automated rollback on error rate / latency spike - OWNER: Oliver
6) Observability: dashboards created, alert thresholds set (token errors, 95p latency, increased 5xxs) - OWNER: Observability (linked)
7) Rollback plan documented and tested on stage (hot fix steps, repo PR rollback) - OWNER: Release Eng
8) Customer comms: support playbook + known issues doc ready - OWNER: Customer Success

Current open blockers (brief):
- RT-3421 (Jira): intermittent KV cache corruption on long running sessions - owner Samir, mitigation applied but needs another 24h of stress; severity: medium-high; impact: potential request failures for multi-turn chat. If still flapping at T-0 we should consider delaying or limiting to read-only features.
- GH#984: runtime PR for attention-kernel fallback still in review (performance tests green but integration test flaky). Owner: Maya, ETA: EOD Thu. If not merged, we can ship with fallback flag disabled (slightly higher latency on long seqs).
- Capacity: cloud provider quota request pending for us-east-1 reserved nodes (Priya chasing). If quota not approved, reduce initial canary to 2% and postpone 20/50 jump.

Rollout/Canary plan (ops runbook draft):
- 00:00: Deploy runtime v2.14.1 to canary pool (5% traffic)
- 00:30: Monitor key metrics (error rate, 95p latency, token cost delta)
- 01:00: If metrics stable, scale to 20%
- 02:00: If still stable, scale to 50%
- 03:00: Full rollout if stable for 1h at 50%
- Automated rollback triggers: 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR 95p latency > +200ms vs baseline for 10m OR error spikes on KV reads > 3x baseline.
- Manual override: Release lead (Oliver) + SRE lead must both sign off for roll forward after any manual rollback.

Monitoring/Alerts to verify before go: (quick checklist)
- Dash: Release Train > Health (token errors, seq length distribution, p95 latency) - link in Confluence.
- Alerts: RT-release-error-rate, RT-p95-latency, RT-kv-errors - ensure oncall has contact + runbook.

Communications:
- Customer Success ready note: short blurb + expected impact (zero for most customers) - Priya to send 30m before major step.
- Internal channels: #release-train (ops), @oncall pager duty.

Action items (before meeting / items I'll raise):
- Samir: confirm extra 24h of KV stress results or propose rollback contingency (due Thu EOD).
- Maya: push failing integration test fix or confirm skip strategy for rollout (Thu EOD).
- Priya: confirm capacity quota or fallback canary sizing (Thu noon).
- Observability: verify alerts wired to PD and test alert escalation (Thu noon).
- Release Eng: rehearse rollback steps on staging and ensure runbook links are live (Thu EOD).

Notes to self:
- If RT-3421 hasn't stabilized, call a quick ad-hoc to assess risk vs. feature impact - prefer delaying non-critical feature toggles rather than global rollback.
- Keep canary conservative if capacity uncertain.
- Capture decisions during meeting in Confluence (I'll update page and tag owners).

Questions to ask during sync:
- Are there any hidden customer migrations/experiments that must be coordinated?
- Any outstanding security/compliance signoff for this model variant?

Quick links (to paste in meeting):
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RT/Release+Train+Mar+2026
- Jira: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RT-3421
- Runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/984

Bottom line: current status is tentatively green but contingent on Samir's KV stress pass and Maya's PR merge. My preference: proceed with 5% canary Friday morning if both items are resolved; otherwise hold and re-evaluate Monday.

[Notes to self - post meeting] will copy decisions + owners into Confluence and follow-up threads.
